---
title: "Milestone Challenge"
---

## Explain what your evidence supports

Create a table of five imaginary arrival times. Write a short summary with two
direct observations and one possible explanation. Identify the additional evidence
you would need to investigate that explanation. Use the unit's observation note
as a starting point.

## Self-review

A useful answer separates observations from assumptions, uses the table accurately,
and names a concrete source of additional evidence. For example, asking about
transport could help explain shared arrival times; the times alone cannot.

This challenge combines the milestone's practice. It is ungraded and does not
require instructor review. You can complete it on a phone or on paper.
